title: P2 Owner/Architect/Inspector: map targets and identify a supported performance suite
body: Cells F1:T7/T8, F2:T7 and F3:T7. No perf script or normalized performance/robustness targets were found by the installed discovery. First map existing specification and error-contract sources; only then ask the appropriate authority for missing targets. Pattern-based test-performance coverage PASS does not prove measured runtime performance. No new k6/mutation workload is authorized. Acceptance: sourced targets and an explicitly scoped executable suite, or an honest remaining blocker. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-34a89f84/.
resolution: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-e9e45a4a/assessment.md — Owner-authorized generous local targets and three request-path scenarios recorded in ADR-0044; no existing threshold changed.
